snippet.title: Alpha Response GameplayTrailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2089250/Alpha_Response/

Alpha Response thrusts players into the role of police officers from around the world. Play Singleplayer or up to 4 player co-op. Large wide open maps with tons of unique missions in each map.
